messages:
Maya: quick heads up — StickerPlay just returned the vendor security questionnaire + DPA edits. They asked about embeddings retention, pseudonymization, and whether our SOC2 scope covers nonprod logs. Need owners and ETA to respond. :wave:
Ethan: noting — are we answering the questionnaire directly or do we send a short cover note + attachments?
Priya: let's do cover note + attachments. Legal will draft the DPA phrasing for the retention piece. Need exact retention windows and which datasets are considered pseudonymized.
Sam: from infra side — embeddings are stored in S3 buckets under `redwood-embeddings/prod/stickerplay/` and we have lifecycle rule to transition to Glacier after 90d and delete after 540d. Nonprod logs are retained 30d. I can pull the lifecycle JSON if needed.
Maya: perfect. @Sam can you paste the lifecycle rule here and confirm whether any backups snapshot those objects beyond delete?
Sam: quick snippet of the lifecycle rule:```{ "Rules": [{"ID":"embeddings-lifecycle","Status":"Enabled","Transitions":[{"Days":90,"StorageClass":"GLACIER"}],"Expiration":{"Days":540}}]}``` No extra snapshots for that bucket; backups exclude embeddings.
Priya: ok that helps. For pseudonymization we can say: identifiers hashed client-side, PII fields are redacted before ingestion, embeddings are one-way and not reversible. Need engineering confirmation on hashing algorithm.
Sam: we use SHA-256 with a per-tenant salt stored in KMS. It's one-way and not reversible. Confirmed.
Ethan: timeline: Legal drafts DPA language today, Sam provides lifecycle JSON and hashing config by EOD, Maya will compile attachments and send back to StickerPlay tomorrow morning. Sounded OK with the customer timeline? They asked for an answer within 48h.
Maya: yep I'll send first-pass to customer by 09:30 PT tomorrow. If Priya can add the legal blurb by EOD that gives me time to assemble.
onboard-bot: checklist update — "StickerPlay: DPA response pending (owners: Priya/Sam), target send: 2026-03-24 09:30 PT" :white_check_mark:
Priya: I'll drop the legal draft to this thread when ready. Will include SOC2 scope callout confirming production environment coverage and SOC2 report availability (redwood-soc2-2025.pdf link).
Maya: thanks team — action items: Priya (draft DPA blurb), Sam (lifecycle JSON + hashing details), Maya (compile & send). I'll post the outgoing note here before sending for a quick read. :thumbsup:
